name: Rat
description: A swift, scruffy scavenger that slips through the shadows with twitching whiskers.

name: Squirrel
description: An agile woodland creature with a bushy tail, bounding between branches.

name: Red Wolf
description: A lean, russet-furred predator with sharp instincts and a commanding presence.

name: Floating Seed
description: A small, round seed with a helix-like appendage. It just shuffles about, searching for fertile ground.

name: Walking Bush
description: A lively shrub with tangled roots that scuttle across the dirt.

name: Holy Tree
description: A small bonsai tree not taller than the average human. Despite its unassuming appearance, these trees belong to an almost extinct ancient species of sentient trees.

name: Dove
description: A gentle bird with soft feathers and a cooing call. It soars gracefully through the air, often seen as a symbol of peace and harmony.

name: Owl
description: A silent hunter with wide, luminous eyes. It glides through the night without a sound.

name: Eagle
description: A fierce bird of prey with sharp talons and keen vision. It flies high above, scanning for prey with intense focus, before diving with unmatched speed and precision.

name: Rockling
description: A tiny, sentient clod of earth and pebbles rolling around enthusiastically.

name: Golem
description: A small, compact figure of dense stone and clay. Despite its size, it is incredibly tough and unyielding, moving with steady purpose, driven by an inner force.

name: Tesseract
description: A geometric cube of shifting planar faces and humming magical matrices.

name: Floating Eye
description: A hovering orb of flesh, bristling with tendrils and stalks. Its gaze is unsettling, filled with cold, alien intelligence.

name: Tentacle Tangle
description: A writhing cluster of cosmic tentacles pulsating with otherworldly energy.

name: Thing from the Abyss
description: An enigmatic eldritch entity coalesced from the deep void.

name: Lizard
description: A small reptile with agile limbs and darting eyes. It scurries nimbly over rocks and through foliage, quick to flick its tongue and bask in the sun.

name: Tree Frog
description: A vibrant, bulbous-eyed amphibian clinging firmly to branches and catching insects in a flash.

name: Crocodile
description: A massive, armored reptile with powerful jaws and a stealthy, low-slung body. It lurks in water, ready to launch explosive ambushes with a swift lunge.

name: Mosquito
description: A tiny, buzzing pest with translucent wings and a needle-sharp proboscis.

name: Beetle
description: A small, hard-shelled insect with sturdy legs and antennae. It scuttles with purpose, often gleaming in metallic colors.

name: Tarantula
description: A large, hairy arachnid with thick legs and potent venom. It waits with patient stillness before striking.

name: Kiara
description: An immortal phoenix born from eternal flames. With radiant warmth and vibrant spirit, she rises anew each time she falls.
exclusiveDescription: Each combat turn: 0.15% × Level chance to revive/protect fallen allies (1 + floor(Level / 50) allies).

name: Senko
description: A divine celestial kitsune dedicated to nurturing and pampering the guild. Unlocks all traits immediately at Level 1.
exclusiveDescription: Empowers guild healing by +(0.6% × Level) as a global multiplier. All traits are active from Level 1.
